en: An illustrated postcard showing an elegant classical statue of a woman on a decorated pedestal in a lush garden setting. The statue stands amid dense green foliage, trees, and manicured pathways, with flowers at the base of the plinth. The style is graphic and decorative, reminiscent of early 20th‑century art. At the bottom margin, the words "WIEN" and "Schwarzenberggarten" are printed, and the artist's signature appears on the right side of the image.
